description: Generates an image from text with up to 9 reference images, higher quality than uni-1 (Luma UNI-1 Max).

prompt.description: Text description of the desired image. 1–6000 characters (nodes_luma.py:827 `validate_string(prompt, min_length=1, max_length=6000)`).

aspect_ratio.description: Output image aspect ratio. `"auto"` lets the model pick and is silently dropped from the wire body (nodes_luma.py:840).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

data.description: Base64-encoded image data. Required with `media_type`; mutually exclusive with `url`.

media_type.description: MIME type (e.g. `image/jpeg`). Required when `data` is set; mutually exclusive with `url`.

output_format.description: Output image format. nodes_luma.py hardcodes `"png"` (line 842); L2 surfaces both with a `png` default.

style.description: Style preset. `"auto"` lets the model pick (omitted from wire). `"manga"` requires a portrait aspect ratio (2:3, 9:16, 1:2, 1:3) or `auto`.

web_search.description: When true, the model may search the web for visual references before generating (nodes_luma.py:658-662).
